title: Slovakian Broccoli Stir Fry with Earthy Curry Sauce
description: A Japanese-inspired stir fry with a unique Slovakian twist, featuring fresh broccoli and a rich earthy curry sauce.
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package instructions.
Marinate the broccoli in soy sauce for 10 minutes.
Heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the broccoli to the wok and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
Add the Slovakian curry powder to the wok and stir for 1 minute.
Pour in the earthy mushroom broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve the broccoli and curry sauce over cooked brown rice.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve immediately.
